notes: SDOGToken has a parameterless constructor that mints all 1000000000000000000000000000 minor units to msg.sender. Its name, symbol, decimals and total supply are fixed constants. Transfers are plain ERC-20 transfers with no fee, tax or transfer limit. There is no owner, admin, further minting, burning, proxy or upgradeability. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice is provenance-only sqrtPriceX96 for paired-currency minor units per SDOG minor unit with SDOG as currency0; the deployer derives the actual opening price from economics and the deployed currency order.
